purpose: Small development set for real-model workflow selection, not writing quality or workflow execution scoring.

complete.note: Expose the same complete, readable material bundle for positive and nearby negative cases. The default files are explicitly synthetic; a runner may substitute a validated real bundle consistently.

idea-only.note: Do not expose completed results in hidden system context for this case.

runnerNotes: Substitute rawMaterialsDir and latexTemplateDir with actual workspace paths; use identical complete materials across the relevant cases.
Verify the selected session model's real image capability and the required native tools before grading positive cases. Missing capability is environment_blocked, not a routing failure or success.
If execution is intercepted to limit expense, label the run selection-only and still validate the real workflowId/input schema; do not treat an empty-argument stub call as successful input mapping.
Forbid means zero workflow_start attempts, even if a host gate would reject them. Record accepted runs separately from attempts.
Ordinary response, existing tools, Skills and delegation are all allowed where workflow_start is forbidden; this set does not prescribe a particular agent.
Score clarification_or_boundary by whether missing evidence or disabled state is communicated correctly; a useful bounded alternative also qualifies. Do not require a gratuitous question.
Keep multi-turn cases in one session. For the completed-result case, use a genuinely recorded completed run or a separately labelled state fixture, not only an assistant claim that work completed.
Preserve model/config, material set, tool catalog, input/output trace, expected decision and actual attempts. Do not infer real-world error rates from this small development set.
